scope: All source-derived members of 3 overlapping families; excludes rituals and the deferred Phase 9 review list. Every member was recompiled under a detached name/ID. Route assessment is not live execution.

families.title: Escape wording
families.definition: Every nonritual, non-review source description that mentions Escape (plain text, action link or inline /act), including penalties, grabs, restraints, wall and summon rules.

members.name: Garden of the Green Man's Growth

families.title: Coordinated condition grants
families.definition: Save outcomes whose text grants two or more conditions in one coordinated list, where positional lifetime scope matters.

families.title: Compiled event-terminated conditions
families.definition: Save outcome conditions compiled with an ending event (Escape, spell end, leaving an area, removal of another condition).
